# Evidence-First Rule — SparkForge AWS

1. Every claim must cite anchored evidence (`fact_id`, source path, line number, or plan node).
2. Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence (`unresolved`).
3. Never invent performance gains or metrics without benchmark facts.
4. Recommendations must contain risks, tradeoffs, validation plan, and rollback.
